videos.title: Not OVERWATCH (CS:GO Overwatch)

top_comments.author: @SMii7Y
top_comments.text:
A lot of people are asking what "Overwatch" on CS:GO is. Well, allow me to explain. On CS:GO, once you achieve 150 competitive match wins, you are able to download demos of others as provided by the Overwatch program. "The Suspect" as seen in the demo has been reported by other people in-game for either; hacks, scripts, griefing, etc. It is the Overwatcher's job to watch over the footage and determine whether the person (The Suspect) is guilty or innocent. This can lead to some funny situations so I figure why not make a video from it :D

Also, "The Suspect" is not the players real in-game name (they purposely cover up all of the names in the demos to avoid witch hunts)

top_comments.author: @SMii7Y
top_comments.text: A lot of people seem to be thinking this is a sponsored video. It's not. If it was sponsored, I am legally obligated to tell you so. I am and have ALWAYS been super dedicated to being fully transparent when it comes to doing sponsored content on my channel. The reason for the confusion seems to be the free BP and crate keys I received at the beginning of the video, so allow me to explain. When you log onto the Test Server (PUBG: Experimental Server), at least during this latest test session. Again, this was my first time playing this map (there were 2-3 previous tests before this). I was prompted with the free keys and BP. Simple as that. To my knowledge, this happened to everyone that played on the Test Server. If you play this again, just a few tips:


1. The AI in this game is OP, sometimes better than players
2. Smaller gray dots on the map are military bases, good loot, insane AI
3. Missions give insane loot, but it turns into a Black Ops Zombies-esc scenario with waves of AI
4. When you kill players, you get Retribution coins. You use these coins to spawn where you died
5. They are still updating the game, and if you look on the map, they are in the process of getting 5-6x more map (and implementing cars and shit)
6. Vodka and Moonshine are used to make better bandages, you shred clothes to rags to heal too (regular=5 HP  sterilized= 15 HP)
7. Bases are currently invincible, so if you build one, as long as you lock it, no one can get in
8. You sell guns, backpacks, pretty much anything for money. You use money to buy food, liquid, and ammo/guns




These are just a few tips, hope it helps

For those upset I didn't play the game with music allow me to explain:

- I have a habit of turning off in-game music when I record content for my channel as it makes the editing smoother and less jarring when jump cutting.
- Unfortunately, a fear of demonetization from content ID from music license issues, etc. I know sound tracks for games it's unlikely this will happen but I just like to err on the side of caution.

I have heard nothing but praise for the soundtrack of this game in the comments so I will definitely replay the game on my own time with the music on!
